import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    c=params
    one=np.ones_like(eps)
    return (c[0]+c[1]*T+c[2]/T+c[3]*T**2
            +(c[4]+c[5]*T+c[6]/T+c[7]*T**2)*np.sqrt(eps)
            +(c[8]+c[9]*T)*eps)
